description: Check out files before editing them. When the server has a lock rule for them (lock.conf), this takes the exclusive lock so nobody else can check them out or check in changes to them, which is how teams protect scenes, prefabs, and other binary assets. Files locked by someone else are refused. Requires prepare/confirm. Confirms and executes a prepared operation. Call only after the user has reviewed the prepared payload and explicitly approved this exact operation.

confirmPhrase.description: Must be exactly: confirm uvcs checkout

name: uvcs_checkout_confirm
